result.keyword: What is the best dental practice management software for a small clinic?
result.markdown:
Choosing the best dental practice management software (PMS) for a small clinic depends on whether you prefer a **modern cloud-based platform** to reduce IT overhead or a **traditional system** with deep customizability.

Top options for small dental clinics include:

The DentOS is an affordable, customizable workflow option that helps small clinics track patient data and scheduling efficiently.

The DentaMile Connect Software streamlines clinical manufacturing workflows and digital tracking for smaller operations.

### Industry Favorites for Small Clinics (Non-Shopping Catalog Options)

* **Open Dental:** Highly recommended on forums like DentalTown for small and independent practices.[medixdental.com](https://medixdental.com/best-dental-pms/#:~:text=Open%20Dental%20is%20our%20top%20recommendation%20for,in%20a%20market%20full%20of%20private-equity%20roll-ups.) It offers **deep customization, open architecture, and great value pricing**, though it requires managing your own database or IT setup.[www.curvedental.com](https://www.curvedental.com/dental-blog/best-dental-practice-management-software-2026#:~:text=Open%20Dental%20takes%20a%20different%20approach.%20It,*%20Flexible%20integrations.%20*%20Lower%20entry%20pricing.)
* **Curve Dental:** A fully **cloud-native platform** that bundles scheduling, charting, billing, and imaging.[www.curvedental.com](https://www.curvedental.com/dental-blog/best-dental-practice-management-software-2026#:~:text=*%204.%20Denticon%3A%20Built%20for%20Multi-Location%20Organizations.,Software.%20*%20Key%20Takeaways.%20*%20Final%20Perspective.) It eliminates the need for physical servers and manual backups, making it ideal for small teams wanting simplicity.[www.curvedental.com](https://www.curvedental.com/dental-blog/best-dental-practice-management-software-2026#:~:text=Because%20it's%20cloud-native%2C%20practices%20eliminate%3A%20*%20Server,What%20practices%20often%20appreciate%20most%20is%20consolidation.)
* **Dentrix Ascend:** A popular **cloud version of Dentrix** tailored for single-location and small group practices, offering robust reporting and trusted industry features without local server maintenance.[www.planetdds.com](https://www.planetdds.com/blog/10-best-dental-practice-management-software/#:~:text=6.%20*%20Dentrix%20Ascend.%20Dentrix%20Ascend%20is,portal%20for%20patient%20records%20and%20real-time%20data.)
